Attaches to receptor on cell membrane (of target cell) 1

Activates secondary messenger inside cell 1

Hyperglycaemia refers to a higher than normal blood glucose level 1

Cells are not receiving glucose leads to reduced cellular respiration 1
This leads to reduced energy released by cells = fatigue 1
Cells being ‘starved’ of energy source = increased appetite 1
Total 3

Total 3
